concerns.text: The Constitution (Principle II) requires that every external citation be verified by the Reference‑Validator Agent. No task in the current task list invokes or schedules such a citation‑validation step, leaving the constitution unfulfilled.

FR‑011 mandates inline code comments throughout the codebase. While README updates are covered (T031a, T112), there is no verification task ensuring that all source files contain adequate inline comments, risking a breach of the functional requirement.
